documentation.content: The /health uptime check is failing from more than one region, so the service is down or unreachable for everyone. Check the Cloud Run service status and the latest revision's logs. /health touches no dependency, so this is the process or the platform, not the database. The condition was generated by the console's Add alert policy action on the uptime check; the check_id label below is that check's own identifier and must match the uptime check in the project.

conditions.displayName: More than one region reports /health failing
